new_page.h1: Buying a Home in Cultus Lake: Zoning, Strata, Land and Tax Rules
new_page.title: Cultus Lake Home Buying Rules: Zoning, Strata & Taxes | Jared Gib
new_page.description: The rules that apply across Cultus Lake when you buy a condo, townhome, lot, acreage or mobile home: zoning, strata, servicing and taxes, with official source

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Collected word for word from the city-wide rules paragraphs of the neighbourhood guides listed at the bottom (D-202); nothing new was added. Each guide keeps what is specific to it and links here.

Buying anywhere in Cultus Lake? These are the rules that apply city-wide, by topic: property taxes, transfer tax and GST, floodplain, farmland and environmental rules, strata, co-op and age rules, zoning, suites and small-scale housing and water, sewer and servicing. The neighbourhood guides cover what is specific to each area. Rules change, so check anything that matters for your purchase with the Cultus Lake Park Board or the Fraser Valley Regional District, depending on the lot and your lawyer before you remove subjects.
Property taxes, transfer tax and GST in Cultus Lake

items.t: Taxes — lease charges and the rural regime, not Chilliwack's dates: Park lease lots pay Park Board lease charges rather than a standard municipal tax bill. For non-Park Electoral Area H land — the regime for a freehold parcel like Lakeside's — taxes are provincial rural taxes under the Taxation (Rural Area) Act s. 11: due July 2, with a 5% penalty on amounts unpaid after July 2 and a further 5% on amounts unpaid after October 31, plus FVRD service-area levies where the lot participates. Chilliwack's penalty dates do not apply to Cultus Lake.

blocks.text: Floodplain, farmland and environmental rules in Cultus Lake

items.t: Sewer versus septic, ALR and hazards: the FVRD operates the sewer system for Cultus Lake in Electoral Area H and publishes a service area map; lots outside a sewer service area use private septic systems regulated by Fraser Health. Much of the non-mountainous part of Electoral Area H west of Lindell Beach is in the Agricultural Land Reserve. The FVRD's Area H guide lists flooding, landslide and slope stability, interface fire, debris slides and flash flooding among local hazards.

Hazards: the FVRD Area H Evacuation Guide lists flooding, landslide and slope stability, interface fire, debris slides and flash flooding among local hazards — read it and price insurance accordingly. The FVRD provides a Flood and Debris Control service in Area H.

blocks.text: Strata, co-op and age rules in Cultus Lake

items.t: Financing note (lease lots): lenders and insurers treat Park Board leasehold homes differently from freehold — for the lease lots (not Lakeside), confirm financing terms against the lease before writing.

blocks.text: Zoning, suites and small-scale housing in Cultus Lake

items.t: Governing zoning and OCP (FVRD — never Chilliwack's bylaws, and never the Park Board's): the FVRD Official Community Plan for Electoral Areas E and H, Bylaw No. 1115 (titled "Columbia Valley, Lindell Beach and Chilliwack River Valley," as amended by Bylaw No. 1533, 2019), covers the south end; zoning is in the FVRD Consolidated Zoning Bylaw No. 1638, 2021. PlanCultus (Bylaw No. 1080, 2016) does not apply here — it applies only inside Cultus Lake Park at the north end.
Zoning — FVRD Cultus Lake Park Zoning Bylaw No. 1375, 2016: The bylaw states no minimum lot area figure for these zones.
Under the OCP designations the only permitted residential use is single family residential use.

blocks.text: Water, sewer and servicing in Cultus Lake

items.t: Services — sewer vs septic, per lot: The FVRD operates a sewer system for Cultus Lake in Electoral Area H and publishes a Cultus Lake Service Area Map; lots outside a sewer service area use private septic systems regulated by the Fraser Health Authority. Confirm sewer versus septic for the exact lot.
Sewer versus septic: the FVRD operates the Cultus Lake sewer system in Electoral Area H under a mapped service area; lots outside a service area use private septic systems regulated by Fraser Health.

blocks.text: Other things to know about buying in Cultus Lake

items.t: Manufactured-home park tenancy: site tenancies are governed by BC's Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act — the tenant owns the home and rents the site under a written agreement. The Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Regulation (B.C. Reg. 481/2003) expressly recognises a park reserved for tenants who have reached 55 and allows a landlord to refuse an assignment where the proposed purchaser does not meet the park's age requirement — which is why Cultus Lake Village's own written rule, not a listing label, decides who can buy in. Pad-rent increase limits: 2026 = 2.3% plus a proportional amount for changes in local government levies and regulated utility fees; 2027 = 2.2% plus proportional; 3 full months' written notice, once every 12 months.
Pad tenure (manufactured homes on rented pads — Lindell Beach Holiday Resort; Cultus Lake Village park): a manufactured home on a rented pad is not lot stock and not land ownership.
